name: Required public package namespaces are present or aliased

applicability.reason: Supported. C029 admits a surface that is PRESENT OR ALIASED by the standard package map, so the `core-package-map-v1` fixture declares all 20 required namespaces and the probe resolves every one. Building it exposed a real defect, now fixed: the builtin service routes are guarded by "a declared name wins", but the guard asked `class_name`, which answers UnsupportedConstruct for a declared MODULE, so `module JSON` was hijacked by the builtin route. Bare-name resolution without the map still answers NameError, which is what the map exists to supply.
